changelog:
- Initial release of dnd-character-generator.
- Generate cinematic D&D and tabletop RPG character portraits from text descriptions.
- Supports custom image sizes and style inheritance with reference images.
- Requires a free Neta API token for image generation.
- Quick setup and usage instructions included for easy integration.
